thesis: High leverage, 38.50x quoted earnings and weakening quarterly conversion outweigh sales growth. The bull concedes recovery remains a prerequisite rather than established evidence.
strongest_counterexample: Revenue increased and FCF is positive, so recovering conversion could support a meaningful turnaround without a sales revival.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of positive year-on-year EPS growth and positive FCF.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if gross debt/equity falls below 100% in a dated balance sheet.
evidence_gaps: Current interest cover, debt maturities and comparable EPS basis.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Quoted trailing P/E 38.50x; forward P/E missing
Revenue growth and positive FCF show continuing operating activity
Sales recovery offers a possible route to better margins, but the supplied evidence has not shown that route materializing
